short_passage: Review derivative: integrative approaches commonly assume isolated, chemically homogeneous pure-protein samples; heterogeneous or polydisperse mixtures require different methods, and relevant conditions or perturbations remain part of interpretation.
atomic_paper_statement: Whether a source can be interpreted as an isolated, chemically homogeneous single-species ensemble depends on declared sample-system and composition context.
proposed_reusable_use: Use only for F02R01's SOURCE-local sample-system/composition declaration. A PASS records that this context is declared; it does not prescribe all construct fields or decide an EDGE relation.
forbidden_generalization: Do not infer a homogeneous chemical species from omitted metadata, treat missing metadata as proof of a mixture, or freeze a universal boundaries/mutations/tags construct schema.
review_disposition_scope: Review-source-supported control logic only. It does not establish a full construct-metadata acceptance rule, a scientific verdict, or an EDGE compatibility result.

source_locator: Thomasen and Lindorff-Larsen 2022, Experimental methods p.543 (local parsed derivative lines 151-161)
short_passage: Review derivative: sources intended to report on the same conformational ensemble should keep buffer and temperature as similar as possible while assessing label-, freezing-, and alignment-medium-dependent perturbations.
atomic_paper_statement: For an intended cross-source relation, conditions and known perturbations must be assessed before the sources are treated as measurements of one conformational ensemble.
proposed_reusable_use: Use only for F02R02's EDGE-only declared condition-relation classification: explicit compatibility can PASS, an explicit mismatch can FAIL, and absent or ambiguous evidence remains UNRESOLVED.
forbidden_generalization: Do not infer comparability from a common modality or nominal label, invent a universal buffer or temperature tolerance, or conflate condition compatibility with validation independence.
review_disposition_scope: Review-source-supported control logic only. It does not set a numerical comparability standard or certify an F06 relation.
